specification.objective: Replace the repeatedly failing Kanban rendering approach with an isolated standard Flutter Scaffold and a lazy two-axis board: horizontally virtualized columns and vertically virtualized card/drop slots. Remove the Kanban route from WorkspaceScaffold/BackdropFilter composition, preserve the existing backend/controller contracts, and keep drag/drop native without nested reorderable or eager scroll/row compositions.

requirements.statement: ProjectKanbanPage must render through its own plain Scaffold/AppBar/body coordinate system and must not mount WorkspaceScaffold, WorkspaceSidebar, BackdropFilter, ambient Stack layers, or the failed compact-sidebar workaround.

The shared navigation drawer remains reusable by exposing the existing drawer widget publicly without changing navigation behavior for other workspace pages; WorkspaceSidebar returns to its original responsive behavior with no forceCompact flag.
KanbanBoardView must render columns lazily with a horizontal ListView and cards/drop slots lazily with vertical ListView.builder rather than SingleChildScrollView + Row/Column eager composition.

Card movement must use a direct draggable handle with native Draggable<KanbanCard> and DragTarget<KanbanCard> slots, preserving same-column index normalization and cross-column moves without ReorderableListView.

Column create/rename/delete/reorder controls, card CRUD, assignees, card numbers, board version, role gating, 409 recovery, controller state, API, persistence, authorization, and backend behavior remain unchanged.
No third-party Flutter drag/drop or Kanban dependency and no browser-specific renderer override may be added.

acceptance_criteria.statement: ProjectKanbanPage contains a standard Scaffold with AppBar and shared navigation drawer and does not contain WorkspaceScaffold; its widget regression test verifies no WorkspaceScaffold or BackdropFilter is mounted.
KanbanBoardView uses a horizontal ListView.separated for lanes and a vertical ListView.builder for each lane's interleaved drop slots/cards, with no SingleChildScrollView or ReorderableListView.
Visible cards retain #cardNumber, title, description, assignees and actions; movable cards expose Draggable<KanbanCard> and lanes expose DragTarget<KanbanCard> drop slots.
The failed forceCompact/wideBreakpoint workaround is removed and non-Kanban workspace layout remains otherwise unchanged.
The focused source-structural POLIS regression transitions from Red on commit a733b56 to Green on the redesigned target, and backend pytest remains green as protected-behavior evidence.

invariants.statement: The exact incremental baseline is remote feature/tasks-kanban commit a733b5644e68460a9d756738a1cb4aca03506bbc with tree adab691085a0c344e3e2b2a2ee9d98de5a238d89.
ProjectTasksController remains the source of frontend authorization/capabilities and the backend remains the authorization boundary.
Board mutations continue sending the existing expectedVersion through the controller; the renderer does not invent optimistic authoritative state.
No backend, schema, API, contract model, pubspec, or web bootstrap file is modified.

forbidden_states.statement: The Kanban page is still rendered beneath WorkspaceScaffold's Stack/BackdropFilter/sidebar layout path.
Kanban columns or cards are eagerly built by SingleChildScrollView + Row/Column or by nested ReorderableListView.
The redesign changes backend/domain/API/controller concurrency semantics or adds a third-party drag/drop dependency.
The old wideBreakpoint double.infinity / forceCompact workaround remains as the Kanban positioning strategy.

inputs.statement: Runtime screenshot after commit a733b56 still shows Kanban content painted underneath/through the compact orange header instead of respecting its layout origin.

Earlier wide-layout evidence showed an offset approximately equal to the 360px workspace sidebar; converting that axis to a compact top header changed the manifestation but did not eliminate it, implicating the shared composited workspace layout path rather than Kanban business state.
Existing STEP-10 requirements call for horizontal Flutter Kanban rendering with native drag/drop and do not require WorkspaceScaffold, ReorderableListView, or an external package.

outputs.statement: Dedicated Kanban screen using standard Scaffold geometry with no workspace backdrop/sidebar compositor in its paint ancestry.
Lazy horizontal lane list and lazy vertical card-slot lists with native handle drag/drop and existing management actions.

failure_semantics.statement: If the dedicated plain Scaffold, public shared drawer, lazy two-axis lists, direct Draggable/DragTarget interaction, removal of eager/reorderable compositions, or removal of forceCompact is absent, the regression command fails closed with kanban_virtualized_board_redesign_missing.

Flutter/Dart tooling is unavailable in this execution environment. POLIS development proof is therefore source-structural; flutter test/analyze/web build/browser smoke must not be claimed as locally executed.

argv:
from pathlib import Path; import sys
root=Path('.')
page=(root/'lib/features/projects/presentation/project_kanban_page.dart').read_text()
board=(root/'lib/features/projects/presentation/widgets/kanban_board.dart').read_text()
shell=(root/'lib/features/shared/presentation/widgets/workspace_shell.dart').read_text()
tests=(root/'test/features/projects/presentation/project_kanban_page_test.dart').read_text()
checks=[
  'return Scaffold(' in page,
  'WorkspaceNavigationDrawer(' in page,
  'WorkspaceScaffold(' not in page,
  'wideBreakpoint: double.infinity' not in page,
  'forceCompact: true' not in page,
  'class WorkspaceNavigationDrawer extends StatelessWidget' in shell,
  'this.forceCompact = false' not in shell,
  'final bool forceCompact;' not in shell,
  'class KanbanBoardView extends StatefulWidget' in board,
  'ListView.separated(' in board,
  'scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal' in board,
  'ListView.builder(' in board,
  'Draggable<KanbanCard>' in board,
  'DragTarget<KanbanCard>' in board,
  'SingleChildScrollView' not in board,
  'ReorderableListView' not in board,
  'LongPressDraggable' not in board,
  "'#${card.cardNumber}'" in board,
  'bypasses the workspace compositor on wide viewports' in tests,
  'virtualizes columns and card slots' in tests,
]
ok=all(checks)
print('kanban_virtualized_board_redesign_ok' if ok else 'kanban_virtualized_board_redesign_missing')
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
